events.title: EPA Finalizes Rule Clarifying "Applicable Requirements" Under Title V Operating Permit Programs
events.summary: The Environmental Protection Agency finalized a rule amending 40 CFR Parts 70 and 71 to clarify the scope of "applicable requirements" under state and federal operating permit programs. The rule codifies the EPA's interpretation that New Source Review (NSR) preconstruction permits issued under EPA-approved state implementation plans or federal implementation plans, with public notice and opportunity for comment and judicial review, establish NSR-related applicable requirements for Title V purposes without further substantive review through the Title V process. The rule also clarifies that general duty clause requirements under CAA section 112(r)(1) are not applicable requirements for Title V purposes.
events.why_relevant: This rule affects the scope of EPA oversight authority over state air permitting decisions and the procedural mechanisms available to challenge preconstruction permits, with implications for regulated entities, state permitting authorities, and public participation in environmental permitting.

events.title: FDA approves vitamin D2 inactive bakers yeast as food additive
events.summary: The Food and Drug Administration finalized a rule amending 21 CFR Part 172 to permit vitamin D2 inactive bakers yeast as a food additive source of vitamin D2 in specified food categories at defined maximum levels. The additive is produced by exposing baker's yeast to ultraviolet light to convert ergosterol to ergocalciferol, then heat-inactivating the yeast. FDA concluded the petitioned uses—substitutional for existing vitamin D2 mushroom powder approvals—pose no safety concern, with cumulative dietary exposure estimates remaining below Institute of Medicine tolerable upper intake levels across all population groups.
